posts.alt_text: Front cover of the word search book Postcards from Everywhere, part of the Golden Hour Puzzles series. The cover shows a winding coastal road leading from a sunny hillside village of white houses down to a turquoise sea with small sailing boats, distant islands on the horizon. Text reads "Travel the world, one puzzle at a time" and "60 puzzles, 1,200+ words, full solutions".
